Task: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing health metrics (invocations, errors,
  throttles, average duration) for a Lambda-based API.

Parameters:
  FunctionName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the Lambda function powering the API.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 140
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid Lambda function name.

  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Dashboard.
    Default: LambdaApiHealthDashboard
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$'

  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: Email address to receive alarm notifications.
    AllowedPattern: '^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid email address.

  ErrorThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of errors over evaluation period that triggers an alarm.
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1

  ThrottleThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of throttles over evaluation period that triggers an alarm.
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1

  DurationThresholdMs:
    Type: Number
    Description: Average duration (ms) over evaluation period that triggers an alarm.
    Default: 3000
    MinValue: 1

Resources:

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-health-alarms'
      DisplayName: !Sub 'Lambda ${FunctionName} Health Alarms'
      KmsMasterKeyId: alias/aws/sns
      Subscription:
        - Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail
          Protocol: email

  ErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-Errors'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Errors detected for Lambda function ${FunctionName}.'
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref FunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref ErrorThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ThrottlesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-Throttles'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Throttles detected for Lambda function ${FunctionName}.'
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Throttles
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref FunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref ThrottleThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  DurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-HighDuration'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'High average duration for Lambda function ${FunctionName}.'
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref FunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref DurationThresholdMs
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  HealthDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "text",
              "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 24, "height": 2,
              "properties": {
                "markdown": "# Lambda API Health Dashboard\n**Function:** `${FunctionName}` | **Region:** `${AWS::Region}`\n\nSummary of invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration."
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0, "y": 2, "width": 6, "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "AWS/Lambda", "Invocations", "FunctionName", "${FunctionName}", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Invocations" } ]
                ],
                "view": "singleValue",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Total Invocations (5m)",
                "period": 300,
                "sparkline": true
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 6, "y": 2, "width": 6, "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
